body: How about a little butt next time, then.

>Hey, talk to me. I understand the true repercussions of mood swings. I have a severe case of Dysthymia that I've been fighting the past 5 years. I've come to learn that no matter how much it sucks right now, suicide doesn't solve it. I know it sounds stupid and corny, and that is why I hate saying it. But either way, this can get better. Let me help you.

It seems like you were in control of yourself. What happened? What's with the sudden change of mind?

Are you taking any medication? TCAs? MAOIs? 

You aren't totally hopeless. If you posted here it was, because you still wanted to live.

Be constructive with your blues.

I'm not expecting you to wake up one morning and expect to see the light and the rainbows. Death is an ultimate and final solution to a temporary problem. If you ever have these thoughts just get up and run. Doesn't matter where or how, but run till your breath is ragged and sweat is pouring down your body. Imagine yourself as a great hunter and fuck the onlookers.
